explication: SingleFile is a browser extension (with a separately documented CLI) that captures a web page as a self-contained HTML archive. The central flow runs from a toolbar, menu, or shortcut request through background task orchestration, page/frame capture, then foreground or background saving and optional upload. Other documented workflows include batch and automatic saves, selection/frame capture, page annotation, configurable profiles, and archive editing. The graph combines excerpted dispatch and calls with README-described capabilities; links for unsampled subsystems are shown only when documented, and some are left unconnected where wiring is not evidenced.
